note: PROVISIONAL held-out set (plan §3.4). Never used in practice; separate structures and stories; three parallel forms A/B/C.

structures.notes: Together-preferring, different favourites; both ways of ending up apart are equally bad (ordinally distinct from every practice structure).
Replaces h.s.m3b (isomorphic to m3.s.one). Only A has a strictly better action; B wants to differ from A, with no ties.

skins.title: Sunday badminton
skins.situation: You and Mira each book a badminton court for Sunday, the indoor court or the outdoor one. Mr Rane, the club manager, takes bookings from anyone.

incentives.h.s.m1a: You like the indoor court more; Mira likes the outdoor one more. Each of you would rather play together than alone.

skins.timing: You book at the same time. Neither sees the other’s booking.
skins.information: You know which court Mira likes. You don’t know which one she will book.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your court and Mira’s court

skins.title: Presenting the plan
skins.situation: You and Ajay each sign up to present the team plan, before the break or after it. Ms Dutta, who chairs the session, keeps both slots open.

incentives.h.s.m1a: You would rather present before the break; Ajay would rather present after it. Both of you want to present together rather than separately.

skins.timing: You sign up at the same time. Neither sees the other’s slot.
skins.information: You know what Ajay wants. You don’t know which slot he will take.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your slot and Ajay’s slot

skins.title: A weekend game
skins.situation: You and your friend Tanvi each pick a game for the weekend: chess at the club or cards at home.

incentives.h.s.m1a: You enjoy chess more; Tanvi enjoys cards more. Each of you would rather play together than alone, so how your weekend goes depends on Tanvi’s pick too.

skins.timing: You both pick on Friday, separately.
skins.information: You know what Tanvi enjoys. You don’t know what she will pick.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your game and Tanvi’s game

skins.title: The shop sign
skins.situation: You put up a sign first, offering free delivery or not. Mr Arora, who runs the shop next door, sees your sign and then decides whether to match it.

incentives.h.s.m1b: Free delivery brings you extra orders, but Mr Arora matching it would take away more than it brings. Matching earns Mr Arora customers, and he gains a little more when you offer delivery too.

skins.timing: You decide first. Mr Arora decides after seeing your sign.
skins.information: Mr Arora sees your sign before choosing. You know how he runs his shop.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your sign and Mr Arora’s reply

skins.title: Film night
skins.situation: You choose first which film to put on, a comedy or a drama. Your sister Diya sees your pick and then decides whether to watch with you or read instead.

incentives.h.s.m1b: How the evening goes for each of you depends on the film and on Diya’s reply.

skins.timing: You choose first. Diya chooses after seeing the film.
skins.information: Diya sees your pick before choosing. You know her tastes.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your film and Diya’s reply

skins.title: Light and dark squares
skins.situation: You place a counter first, on a light square or a dark square. The other side sees where it is, then places theirs on a light or a dark square.

incentives.h.s.m1b: What each side gets depends on where both counters end up.

skins.timing: You place first. The other side places after seeing yours.
skins.information: The other side sees your counter before choosing. Each side knows the rules.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your square and the other side’s square

skins.title: Market day
skins.situation: You and Salim, two wholesalers, each pick which day to bring goods to the weekly market: Tuesday or Friday.

incentives.h.s.m2a: Most buyers come on the day both of you are there, and a shared Friday draws more of them than a shared Tuesday. A wholesaler on his own still gets a few buyers on a Friday, but hardly any on a Tuesday.

skins.timing: You both decide at the start of the week, separately.
skins.information: You both know what the other wants. You don’t know Salim’s day.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your day and Salim’s day

skins.title: The residents’ meeting
skins.situation: You and Rekha are organising a residents’ meeting. Each of you sends out a notice with a time, afternoon or evening, without checking with the other.

incentives.h.s.m2a: Matching notices fill the room, and a shared evening suits you both better than a shared afternoon. If the notices differ, a few residents still come in the evening, hardly anyone in the afternoon.

skins.timing: You both send your notice on the same day.
skins.information: You both know what the other wants. You don’t know which time Rekha will send.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your time and Rekha’s time

skins.title: Two buttons
skins.situation: You and the other side each press one of two buttons, round or flat, at the same moment.

incentives.h.s.m2a: Matching buttons pay you both, and two flat buttons pay more than two round ones. If the buttons differ, whoever pressed flat still gets a little and whoever pressed round gets nothing.

skins.timing: You both press at the same moment.
skins.information: Each side knows what the other wants. You don’t know which button will be pressed.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your button and the other side’s button

skins.title: Training for a race
skins.situation: You are training for a local race. You decide whether to practise hill runs or flat runs, while the organiser, Mr Nair, decides whether the course will be flat or hilly.

incentives.h.s.m2b: Hill practice pays off well on a hilly course and not at all on a flat one; flat runs help a little either way, more on a flat course.

skins.timing: You both decide this month, separately.
skins.information: You know how Mr Nair plans. You don’t know which course he will set.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your training and the course

skins.title: Packing for a visit
skins.situation: You are visiting Mrs Kapoor in the hills. You decide whether to pack a heavy coat or a light jacket, while she decides whether to plan an indoor day or an outdoor day.

incentives.h.s.m2b: The coat is a great help on an outdoor day and a burden indoors; the jacket is fine either way, a little better indoors.

skins.timing: You both decide before the visit, separately.
skins.information: You know what Mrs Kapoor enjoys. You don’t know which day she will plan.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your packing and her plan

skins.title: The interview
skins.situation: You are preparing for a job interview by revising technical questions or practising a presentation. Dr Sen, who chairs the panel, decides whether the interview will be a presentation or a technical test.

incentives.h.s.m2b: Technical revision pays off well in a technical test and not at all for a presentation; presentation practice helps a little either way, more for a presentation.

skins.timing: You both prepare this week, separately.
skins.information: You know how Dr Sen runs panels. You don’t know which format she will choose.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your preparation and the format

skins.title: The grant report
skins.situation: You and Bina are each writing half of a grant report. Each of you decides whether to follow the shared template or use your own layout.

incentives.h.s.m3a: The template saves you a day of formatting, and the report reads best when both halves follow it. If only one half uses its own layout, its writer has to redo it to fit. Bina is in the same position.

skins.timing: You both write this week, separately.
skins.information: You both know what is at stake for each other. You don’t know Bina’s choice.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your layout and Bina’s layout

skins.title: The practice court
skins.situation: You and Sameer share a practice court. Each of you decides whether to book your slot online in advance or just turn up.

incentives.h.s.m3a: Booking ahead guarantees you a slot, and practice is best when you have both booked. If one of you just turns up while the other has booked, the one who turns up finds the court taken. Sameer is in the same position.

skins.timing: You both decide during the week, separately.
skins.information: You both know what is at stake for each other. You don’t know Sameer’s choice.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your booking and Sameer’s booking

skins.title: Collection day
skins.situation: You and your neighbour Rupa each decide whether to put your bins out the night before collection or in the morning.

incentives.h.s.m3a: A bin put out the night before catches the early truck, and the lane is tidiest when both bins go out together. A morning bin next to one that stood out all night is usually too late. Rupa is in the same position.

skins.timing: You both decide each week, separately.
skins.information: You both know what is at stake for each other. You don’t know Rupa’s choice.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for your timing and Rupa’s timing

skins.title: Two sweet shops
skins.situation: Mr Lal, who runs the bigger sweet shop, decides whether to hold his sale this week or next. You run a smaller shop and decide whether to hold yours this week or next.

incentives.h.s.m3c@B: Mr Lal’s festival stock arrives this week, so an early sale helps him clear it, and he gains when your sale is next week. You do better in a different week from his; a clash this week is worst for you.

skins.information: You know how Mr Lal plans. You don’t know which week he will choose.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for Mr Lal’s sale and yours

skins.title: Two cultural evenings
skins.situation: The bigger residents’ group, led by Mr Varma, decides whether to hold its cultural evening on Saturday or Sunday. Your small group decides which day to hold its own.

incentives.h.s.m3c@B: Mr Varma’s group has the hall cheaply on Saturday, and gains when your evening is on Sunday. Your group does better on a different day from his; a clash on Saturday is worst for you.

skins.timing: Both groups announce at the same meeting.
skins.information: You know how Mr Varma’s group plans. You don’t know his day.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for Mr Varma’s day and yours

skins.title: North and south lamps
skins.situation: At the same moment, the other side lights the north or the south lamp, and you light the north or the south lamp.

incentives.h.s.m3c@B: The other side earns a bonus for lighting north, and another when your lamp is south. You gain when your lamp differs from theirs; both lamps on north is the worst for you.

skins.timing: You both light a lamp at the same moment.
skins.information: Each side sees the whole table. You don’t know which lamp the other side will light.
skins.matrixLabel: Outcomes for the other side’s lamp and yours
